officialSources.verified: Public statement says preceding-day 16:00 MOPS bond facts and ratings plus broker reference curves drive modeled fair values; does not itself prove historical day-by-day vintage snapshots.

Methodology notes specify eligibility, rating precedence, subordinated one-notch adjustment, previous-day 16:00 rating source and potential issuer/MOPS update lag. One dated report is not multi-date transport.

mechanismHypotheses.support: Model reference curve is selected using security/guarantor/issuer ratings; a rating change may mechanically alter model yield even without an independent traded-bond repricing.
mechanismHypotheses.counter: Broker reference curves can independently move, and actual transactions may convey separate information.
mechanismHypotheses.alternative: Benchmark-rate, tenor, liquidity, tax, option and technical effects.
mechanismHypotheses.failure: No dated model-input rating/curve lineage or independent trade/quote receipts; do not count rating and model-yield moves as two independent votes.

mechanismHypotheses.support: TPEx documentation describes previous-day 16:00 MOPS bond/rating input. Rating agency publication and MOPS input vintage can differ.
mechanismHypotheses.counter: An earlier rating update may already be reflected in the eligible prior-day snapshot; do not assume all marks lag.
mechanismHypotheses.alternative: Stale MOPS metadata, issuer reporting lag, holiday/report cutoffs, model calculation and report-publication delays.
mechanismHypotheses.failure: No authenticated per-security input-vintage or report publication timestamp; do not assert the model did or did not incorporate the action.

mechanismHypotheses.support: Fixed-rate, NTD, <=10y remaining, no put/call, rating and formula eligibility constraints censor model coverage.
mechanismHypotheses.counter: Security rating or qualifying guarantee can preserve eligibility despite issuer-rating changes.
mechanismHypotheses.alternative: Maturity, call, delisting, data-source interruption or identity-mapping failure.
mechanismHypotheses.failure: No dated independent outstanding universe plus per-security eligibility; absence is UNKNOWN, never zero risk.

mechanismHypotheses.support: Monthly outstanding data period is not equivalent to publication knownAt and cannot be treated as daily state.
mechanismHypotheses.counter: Archived immutable release-time snapshots could provide legitimate delayed monthly controls.
mechanismHypotheses.alternative: Delayed reporting, restated balances, corporate actions or security ID changes.
mechanismHypotheses.failure: Period-end values are joined before first-publication time or treated as same-day trades.
